rows.ARS:
Deep yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Mélissa ® (hybrid tea, Sauvageot, 2000)
Exhibition name: Mélissa ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Bernard Sauvageot (France, 2000).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 2008 as 'Golden Silk'.
rows.Bloom: Deep yellow. Strong, citrus fragrance. up to 38 petals. Medium, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm). Width: 2' to 28" (60 to 70cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
